newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were able to recover to end mostly softer but well above session lows.

Swiss bonds early took direction from softer U.S. prices, which faltered on news of a U.S. strike against Iraq. The news fed worries of higher oil prices. But news the National Association of Purchasing Management index rose by less than expected to 52.6 in August from 50.2 in July helped to calm market nervousness before U.S. jobs data on Friday.
One futures trader said Swiss bonds lately had outperformed Bunds, possibly helped by the weak Swiss economy and the strong Swiss franc. The trend was still evident Tuesday, he said.
Sept conf bond down two at 112.93.
Sept comi medium-term bond down 16 at 109.24.
Sept Euro Swiss francs up one at 97.81. -- Cash:
